contracts.name: principled_main_specular_uses_dielectric_fresnel
contracts.description: Principled main dielectric specular must use true dielectric Fresnel so eta=1 has zero reflection.

contracts.name: non_principled_conductor_uses_conductor_wrapper
contracts.description: The non-principled conductor branch should use the material-model wrapper over the reflection lobe.

contracts.name: non_principled_dielectric_uses_dielectric_wrapper
contracts.description: Non-principled non-metals should retain dielectric reflection independently of their BTDF coefficient.

contracts.name: smooth_conductor_is_layer_composite_helper
contracts.description: Smooth conductor routing should live in LayerComposite and consume the canonical material smooth flag.

contracts.name: lobe_context_does_not_cache_smooth_flag
contracts.description: LobeContext should not cache smooth/delta state; conductor smoothness is derived by IsSmoothConductor where needed.

contracts.name: path_sampling_uses_layer_composite_smooth_conductor_helper
contracts.description: Direct-light sampling should skip smooth conductor surfaces through LayerComposite after the global PathSurface helper is removed.

contracts.name: principled_clearcoat_has_disney_energy_scale
contracts.description: Disney/Mitsuba principled clearcoat contribution adapts the standard BxDF BRDF convention with clearcoat * 0.25 and 4*NoV*NoL.

contracts.name: non_principled_clearcoat_uses_bxdf_without_disney_adapter
contracts.description: Non-principled clearcoat should use the BxDF clearcoat BRDF directly instead of the Disney/Mitsuba denominator adapter.

contracts.name: principled_diffuse_uses_burley_and_sheen
contracts.description: Principled diffuse path must use Burley diffuse plus the additive sheen term.

contracts.name: sheen_eval_separates_physical_and_principled_models
contracts.description: Non-principled sheen should use the BxDF sheen model while principled keeps its Disney-compatible additive sheen term.

contracts.name: composite_eval_drops_principled_evaluate_wrappers
contracts.description: Principled diffuse/specular/clearcoat should be handled inside the generic Evaluate*BRDF helpers.

contracts.name: boundary_eval_sums_physical_components
contracts.description: The boundary evaluator should sum reflection-side closures and the independently weighted BTDF-only transmission closure.

contracts.name: boundary_marginal_pdf_uses_resolved_lobe_mixture
contracts.description: The boundary PDF should marginalize distinct reflection and BTDF-only transmission proposals in solid angle.

contracts.name: path_surface_lobes_file_removed
contracts.description: PathSurfaceLobes.hlsli helpers should be absorbed into PathComposite so the extra wrapper file stays removed.

contracts.name: sample_flags_accumulate_full_history
contracts.description: Path continuation diagnostics should accumulate every sampled layer event and publish the history flags only when the walk escapes.

contracts.name: boundary_marginal_pdf_excludes_delta_specular_mass
contracts.description: The solid-angle boundary PDF should exclude the smooth reflection atom and include only continuous reflection density.

contracts.name: production_path_uses_layer_composite_sampling
contracts.description: The production path tracer loop should sample BSDF histories through LayerComposite.

contracts.name: production_direct_lighting_uses_directional_composite_queries
contracts.description: Direct-light NEE should obtain BSDF value and direction PDF from DirectionalComposite.

contracts.name: production_environment_lighting_uses_directional_composite_queries
contracts.description: Environment NEE should obtain BSDF value and direction PDF from DirectionalComposite.

contracts.name: validation_header_does_not_control_production_lighting
contracts.description: PathValidation must not define macros that alter production lighting signatures or estimators.

contracts.name: validation_header_does_not_own_validation_default
contracts.description: PathValidation may consume PT_VALIDATION but must not provide its fallback definition.

contracts.name: validation_lobe_instrumentation_does_not_supply_radiance
contracts.description: Validation-only lobe classification must remain separate from the DirectionalComposite value used for production radiance.

contracts.name: path_composite_precedes_sampling_in_include_graph
contracts.description: PathTracer should include the unified composite API before PathSampling consumes it.

contracts.name: directional_composite_namespace_owns_direction_queries
contracts.description: Evaluate and MarginalPDF should expose the same direction-query inputs under BxDF::DirectionalComposite.

contracts.name: directional_evaluate_does_not_dispatch_by_layer_count
contracts.description: DirectionalComposite::Evaluate should be one generic implementation rather than a one-layer/N-layer dispatcher.

contracts.name: directional_marginal_pdf_does_not_dispatch_by_layer_count
contracts.description: DirectionalComposite::MarginalPDF should be one generic implementation rather than a one-layer/N-layer dispatcher.

contracts.name: directional_evaluate_owns_physical_prefix_and_delta_suffix
contracts.description: Evaluate must accumulate physical Radiance prefixes and Importance-mode exact-delta suffixes before evaluating the continuous connection.

contracts.name: directional_marginal_pdf_is_probability_only
contracts.description: MarginalPDF may sample proposal transitions and compensated query RR, but must not accumulate physical event weights or Beer attenuation.

contracts.name: directional_marginal_pdf_maps_exact_delta_tail
contracts.description: MarginalPDF must terminate reverse suffixes at non-delta events and push continuous density through exact transmission with the solid-angle Jacobian.

contracts.name: directional_query_rng_streams_are_separate
contracts.description: Physical evaluation and PDF proxy queries must derive independent endpoint-only random streams.
contracts.detail: distinct values and use sites verified

contracts.name: directional_pdf_preserves_zero_measure_without_floor
contracts.description: A query with no reachable continuous stratum must return zero, and continuous queries must return the estimator itself without a positive PDF floor.

contracts.name: directional_pdf_has_no_positive_floor
contracts.description: DirectionalComposite::MarginalPDF must not invent continuous density where the estimator is zero.

contracts.name: directional_continuous_mis_uses_generalized_power_strategy_ratios
contracts.description: Every continuous split must compare collapsed BoundaryMarginalPDF densities through the generalized power-strategy ratio recurrence.

contracts.name: directional_pdf_uses_generalized_power_mis_and_log_density_ratio
contracts.description: The directional PDF estimator must convert reverse proposals to the forward measure in log space and use the same generalized split MIS recurrence as Evaluate.

contracts.name: directional_endpoint_mis_excludes_layer_event_joint_pdf
contracts.description: Endpoint connection MIS must compare direction-space marginals rather than LayerEvent's lobe-label joint PDF or PMF.

contracts.name: layer_and_directional_composites_share_one_header
contracts.description: PathComposite should own LayerComposite sampling helpers and DirectionalComposite direction queries without a second fixed-endpoint header.

contracts.name: legacy_bsdf_wrappers_removed
contracts.description: PathTracerLIB should not keep old global BSDF wrapper names once production uses the composite APIs directly.

contracts.name: surface_lobe_aovs_use_composite_mixture
contracts.description: Surface lobe AOVs should expose the same four-slot proposal mixture without a second Fresnel split.

contracts.name: surface_lobe_mask_uses_composite_mixture
contracts.description: Surface lobe mask AOV should be based on the composite lobe PMF, not a duplicated BSDF-type branch table.

contracts.name: production_aovs_use_layer_composite_lobe_api
contracts.description: Validation AOV writes should call the LayerComposite lobe helper API directly.

contracts.name: raygen_routes_aovs_through_validation_helper
contracts.description: Ray-generation should keep validation AOV writes behind the PathValidation helper route.

contracts.name: lobe_mixture_uses_btdf_only_transmission_slot
contracts.description: Composite routing should keep reflection in the specular slot and assign (1-M)T to the BTDF-only slot.

contracts.name: dielectric_specular_eligibility_is_parameter_derived
contracts.description: Non-principled dielectric reflection eligibility should be independent of transmission and derive from metallic, strength, tint, and relative eta.

contracts.name: surface_material_no_half_threshold_transmission
contracts.description: Partial transmission should be routed as a mixed dielectric BSDF, not as a binary glass switch.

contracts.name: boundary_pdf_mixes_reflection_and_btdf_proposals
contracts.description: The direction marginal must combine reflection and BTDF proposal densities with their resolved slot PMFs.

contracts.name: smooth_reflection_atom_has_no_continuous_pdf
contracts.description: An exact smooth reflection is an atom and must not enter the solid-angle boundary marginal PDF.

contracts.name: sampling_uses_resolved_layer_event_route
contracts.description: Each boundary should resolve and sample one lobe in SampleLayerEvent, while SampleRay composes those events into a history walk.

contracts.name: layer_event_is_history_conditioned
contracts.description: A sampled LayerEvent must retain the selected lobe's C/q weight and the matching slot-times-event mixed density or mass.

contracts.name: history_sample_has_no_external_pdf_field
contracts.description: PathBSDFSample must contain only sampled-history state, not a fixed-endpoint direction PDF.

contracts.name: history_sample_does_not_query_external_pdf
contracts.description: SampleRay must not evaluate the independent fixed-endpoint marginal PDF internally.

contracts.name: trace_path_assembles_continuation_marginal_pdf
contracts.description: TracePath must query the independent DirectionalComposite PDF after LayerComposite has produced wi.

contracts.name: trace_path_continuation_marginal_pdf_is_layer_agnostic
contracts.description: Continuous continuation samples must use the same marginal-PDF validity rule for every layer count.

contracts.name: sampling_no_bsdf_type_specific_dispatch_functions
contracts.description: LayerComposite sampling should not be split into one SampleXXX function per bsdfType.

contracts.name: legacy_lobe_sample_stack_removed
contracts.description: Terminal LayerEvent sampling should replace the old finalized per-lobe sampler stack.

contracts.name: component_lobe_mixture_weights_are_explicit_and_normalized
contracts.description: LayerComposite should explicitly derive diffuse/specular/clearcoat/BTDF proposal weights and normalize them once.

contracts.name: clearcoat_boundary_evaluation_is_enabled
contracts.description: Clearcoat must contribute to the glossy boundary value used by direct lighting and fixed-endpoint queries.

contracts.name: clearcoat_boundary_marginal_pdf_is_enabled
contracts.description: The direction-space mixture PDF must include the clearcoat proposal with its slot probability.

contracts.name: clearcoat_is_a_continuous_directional_proposal
contracts.description: The fixed-endpoint marginal-PDF estimator must remain active for clearcoat even when the base lobe is smooth.

contracts.name: surface_weight_helpers_removed
contracts.description: PathSurface should only classify and assemble surface data; composite lobe weights are resolved in PathComposite.

contracts.name: composite_weight_context_removed
contracts.description: LayerComposite lobe routing should not carry precomputed diffuse/conductor or principled helper weights through a context object.

contracts.name: composite_main_flow_avoids_bsdf_type_routing
contracts.description: Composite evaluation/PDF/sampling should derive lobe weights from material parameters rather than the validation/classification bsdfType field.

contracts.name: btdf_sampling_is_layer_event_handler
contracts.description: The generic layer-event switch should sample direction through Transmission and evaluate material response through Dielectric.

contracts.name: emissive_hit_uses_delta_aware_mis_helper
contracts.description: Emitter hits should pass the previous sample's delta state to the shared MIS helper.

contracts.name: emissive_surface_accumulates_then_continues
contracts.description: An emissive hit should add EDF radiance with emitter-hit MIS and still continue through its BSDF closure.
contracts.detail: emission is accumulated with MIS before BSDF continuation

contracts.name: dielectric_reflection_is_not_disabled_by_transmission
contracts.description: Transmission controls the BTDF coefficient and must not disable the dielectric reflection closure.

contracts.name: rough_dielectric_slots_use_fresnel_safety_mixture
contracts.description: Separate rough dielectric reflection/transmission slots should mix their Fresnel-guided proposal with a uniform safety proposal without changing either physical closure.

contracts.name: transmissive_dielectric_support_is_independent_of_reflection_scale
contracts.description: An active dielectric BTDF must retain proposal support even when the separately tinted or scaled reflection closure is disabled.

contracts.name: rough_dielectric_proposal_safety_mix_is_twenty_percent
contracts.description: The rough dielectric proposal should reserve twenty percent for the symmetric safety proposal, bounding both reflection and transmission slot weights away from zero.

contracts.name: transmission_slot_does_not_sample_reflection
contracts.description: The BTDF-only slot should not make a second Fresnel reflection decision after slot selection.

contracts.name: smooth_layer_events_use_unit_conditional_mass
contracts.description: Selected smooth reflection and transmission atoms should use conditional mass one before multiplication by slot PMF.

contracts.name: delta_bounce_mis_weight_is_unity
contracts.description: The shared MIS helper should return unity for a previous delta BSDF sample.

contracts.name: bxdf_diffuse_is_burley
contracts.description: BxDF diffuse EvaluateBRDF should be Disney/Burley diffuse, not Lambert only.

contracts.name: bxdf_clearcoat_uses_gtr1_fixed_f0
contracts.description: BxDF clearcoat should use GTR1 distribution and fixed F0=0.04 Schlick Fresnel.

contracts.name: bxdf_reflection_and_transmission_are_lobe_namespaces
contracts.description: Reflection and Transmission should expose separate direction/PDF/value lobe APIs.

contracts.name: bxdf_dielectric_wrapper_assembles_fresnel_lobes
contracts.description: Dielectric should remain a material-model wrapper that composes Fresnel with Reflection and Transmission lobes.

contracts.name: reflection_pdf_excludes_smooth_atom
contracts.description: Reflection::EvaluatePDF should describe only continuous solid-angle density.

contracts.name: reflection_brdf_excludes_smooth_atom
contracts.description: Reflection::EvaluateBRDF should exclude the exact-delta reflection atom.

contracts.name: transmission_pdf_excludes_smooth_atom
contracts.description: Transmission::EvaluatePDF should describe only continuous solid-angle density.

contracts.name: transmission_btdf_excludes_smooth_atom
contracts.description: Transmission::EvaluateBTDF should exclude the exact-delta transmission atom.

contracts.name: transmission_lobe_does_not_own_fresnel
contracts.description: Transmission receives the physical one-minus-F coefficient from the dielectric wrapper rather than evaluating Fresnel itself.

contracts.name: conductor_wrapper_composes_reflection_lobe
contracts.description: Conductor should provide smooth and rough material-model reflection wrappers over Fresnel and Reflection.

contracts.name: authoring_material_preserves_opacity_and_flags
contracts.description: The authoring material should preserve base-color alpha and imported material-mode flags.

contracts.name: authoring_material_flag_bits_are_stable
contracts.description: Authoring material flags must retain the CPU/GPU bit assignments used by the shader.

contracts.name: material_render_view_carries_opacity
contracts.description: The game-thread render view should carry opacity independently from RGB tint.

contracts.name: gpu_material_uses_128_byte_root_and_semantic_span
contracts.description: The shared C++ GPU material should keep opacity while replacing fixed texture IDs with one compact semantic-table span.

contracts.name: shader_material_opacity_matches_cpp_slot
contracts.description: The shader MaterialData layout should place opacity immediately after alphaCutoff like ShaderTypes.h.

contracts.name: gpu_cpp_material_flag_bits_are_stable
contracts.description: ShaderTypes.h material flags must match the authoring and shader definitions.

contracts.name: shader_material_flag_bits_match_cpp
contracts.description: Common.bsh material flags must match ShaderTypes.h exactly.

contracts.name: mesh_system_preserves_imported_flags_and_alpha
contracts.description: MeshSystem should forward tint alpha and OR face-normal state into imported flags instead of overwriting them.

contracts.name: dx12_scene_resource_copies_opacity
contracts.description: The D3D12 material upload should copy render-view opacity into the shared GPU struct.

contracts.name: vulkan_scene_resource_copies_opacity
contracts.description: The Vulkan material upload should copy render-view opacity into the shared GPU struct.

contracts.name: read_opacity_multiplies_factor_and_texture_alpha
contracts.description: Coverage should be base-color factor alpha times texture alpha, saturated once at the boundary.

contracts.name: read_opacity_is_independent_of_alpha_mode
contracts.description: ReadOpacity should evaluate coverage only; alpha mode and cutoff routing belong to callers.

contracts.name: trace_path_uses_post_jitter_forwarded_rng
contracts.description: TracePath must continue the caller's post-jitter RNG stream while validation uses a separately salted stream.
contracts.detail: forwarded RNG verified across 3 TracePath calls

contracts.name: primary_alpha_blend_is_topology_only_null_loop
contracts.description: Primary ALPHA_BLEND null events should re-trace from a later TMin without consuming depth or mutating transport state.
contracts.detail: null traversal changes only the ray segment minimum

contracts.name: alpha_mask_and_shadow_blend_are_separate
contracts.description: Any-hit should keep MASK deterministic while enabling stochastic BLEND only for shadow visibility.
contracts.detail: deterministic MASK and stochastic shadow BLEND are separate

contracts.name: shadow_payload_carries_alpha_seed
contracts.description: Both finite and infinite shadow queries must initialize their stochastic alpha seed and force any-hit execution.
contracts.detail: both shadow visibility queries initialize their alpha seed

contracts.name: nee_consumes_fresh_shadow_alpha_seed
contracts.description: Direct and environment NEE should consume exactly one fresh random seed for each visibility query.
contracts.detail: each NEE visibility query consumes one fresh alpha seed

contracts.name: shadow_alpha_hash_identifies_each_candidate
contracts.description: Shadow alpha sampling should distinguish each instance, primitive, and ray distance before its unit-float comparison.
contracts.detail: shadow candidates derive independent normalized alpha variates

contracts.name: path_composite_excludes_alpha_coverage
contracts.description: Opacity coverage is a topology decision and must not enter BSDF evaluation, sampling, or MIS.
contracts.detail: BSDF composite is independent of alpha coverage

contracts.name: rng_unit_float_conversion_is_strictly_half_open
contracts.description: Random uint conversion must guarantee [0,1) in float32 instead of rounding large uints to one.
contracts.detail: 24-bit conversion guarantees a strict half-open unit interval

contracts.name: alpha_probability_sanity
contracts.description: Deterministic Monte Carlo probes should recover surface coverage and independent one/two-blocker visibility.

contracts.name: anisotropy_texture_uses_khr_direction_and_strength
contracts.description: KHR anisotropy textures must decode RG as a direction, multiply strength by B, and combine the uniform rotation.

contracts.name: anisotropy_texture_binding_preserves_rgb
contracts.description: The material texture table must retain all RGB channels of the linear KHR anisotropy texture.

contracts.name: model_loader_imports_khr_anisotropy
contracts.description: ModelLoader must retain the KHR anisotropy factor, rotation, and packed RGB texture.

contracts.name: microfacet_roughness_parameterization_is_model_specific
contracts.description: Analytic materials author GGX alpha directly; Principled materials square perceptual roughness exactly once before anisotropy maps the resolved alpha.
contracts.detail: analytic alpha=r; Principled alpha=r^2; anisotropy maps resolved alpha

contracts.name: reference_scene_roughness_helpers_route_by_material_model
contracts.description: Reference emitters must keep analytic alpha direct, reserve perceptual r^2 for Principled pbrt_equiv, and route conductors through the OpenPBR axis mapping.
contracts.detail: analytic dielectric/plastic/nested interfaces use direct alpha; Principled pbrt_equiv alone uses r^2; conductors use OpenPBR alpha axes

contracts.name: reference_scene_roughness_helpers_numeric_sanity
contracts.description: The actual scene_gen helper functions must numerically distinguish analytic alpha, Principled perceptual r^2, and OpenPBR anisotropic authored-alpha axes.

contracts.name: cornell_material_map_uses_raw_alpha_texture
contracts.description: The non-Principled material-map scene must pass its raw linear roughness map directly as the conductor GGX alpha texture.
contracts.detail: raw linear roughness_map is passed directly to conductor alpha_texture

contracts.name: anisotropy_alpha_models_match_openpbr_and_khr
contracts.description: Analytic materials apply the OpenPBR axis mapping to authored GGX alpha while Principled materials apply the KHR mapping to perceptual r^2.

contracts.name: anisotropy_smooth_classification_uses_final_alpha_pair
contracts.description: Delta classification must use the resolved anisotropic alpha pair rather than base roughness alone.

contracts.name: anisotropy_payload_keeps_world_tangent_sign
contracts.description: The 64-byte DXR payload should carry tangent xyz plus world-space frame parity without duplicating materialID.

contracts.name: anisotropy_backface_orientation_preserves_frame_parity
contracts.description: Opaque backface orientation must flip both N and tangent-frame parity.

contracts.name: anisotropy_normal_map_hemisphere_fix_preserves_frame_parity
contracts.description: Normal-map hemisphere correction must flip both the normal and signed tangent-frame parity.

contracts.name: anisotropy_geometric_hemisphere_fix_preserves_frame_parity
contracts.description: Resolved path-surface hemisphere correction must flip both the shading normal and tangent parity.

contracts.name: anisotropy_nlayer_queries_share_signed_surface_parameterization
contracts.description: Every internal layer should load its own anisotropy data while sharing the root surface tangent parity.

contracts.name: roughness_parameterization_numeric_sanity
contracts.description: Deterministic probes distinguish analytic GGX alpha from Principled perceptual r^2 and verify anisotropy is layered on the model-specific base alpha.
contracts.detail: r=0.4: analytic isotropic alpha=0.4, Principled isotropic alpha=0.16; anisotropic analytic=(0.54879547,0.13719887), Principled=(0.63250000,0.16000000)

contracts.name: anisotropy_numeric_sanity
contracts.description: Deterministic probes verify OpenPBR conservation, KHR directional roughness, B-channel strength, and mirrored-frame parity.

contracts.name: model_loader_imports_gltf_material_semantics
contracts.description: ModelLoader should retain glTF base RGBA/opacity, principled roughness mode, IOR, alpha mode, sidedness, emission, and base-color texture semantics.

contracts.name: plain_gltf_principled_derives_dielectric_f0_from_final_ior
contracts.description: A plain metallic-roughness glTF has no explicit specular color, so its Principled F0 must be derived from the final imported IOR.

contracts.name: cornell_principled_glass_uses_principled_transmission
contracts.description: The Principled glass reference scene must use perceptual roughness 0.4, IOR 1.5, full transmission, and the Principled material tag.
